eb1e9858-5d3c-4c3e-a394-12c5b4d0b55f.title: Re:Monster
eb1e9858-5d3c-4c3e-a394-12c5b4d0b55f.description: Tomokui Kanata has been reincarnated into the weakest race, goblin, and given a new name, Gobrou, after having undergone an unfortunate death. However, Gobrou has retained his previous life's memories and ability to learn skills from what he eats. In this alternate world of survival of the fittest, events unfold. Will a goblin party become the heroes of this world, in a delightful twist from your usual scenario?

a0a5528a-c4a8-4495-a966-6877c12856ba.title: TRUMP
a0a5528a-c4a8-4495-a966-6877c12856ba.description:
Sophie, a boy with vampire and human blood, is transferred from an orphanage to an institution called Clan. The school houses vampire boys who have reached their Cocoon period, or puberty in human terms. Sophie has a fateful encounter with a boy named Ul while being coldly greeted by the vampires around him. As Ul continues to research the “power of immortality” that vampires once possessed, he learns of the existence of TRUMP, the original vampire that is said to live forever, and begins to crave eternal life.

Eventually, Sophie and Ul become entangled in the deep fate surrounding the legend of immortality...

A manga adaptation of the origin story of playwright Kenichi Suemitsu’s popular series! A Gothic school fantasy that beautifully spins the conflicts of impressionable and sensitive boysー!

chapters.title: Blood Alliance Congress in the Cabinet Room

cb98bd40-a903-4416-bdd0-dab93d8f36ad.title: R15+ ja Dame desu ka?
cb98bd40-a903-4416-bdd0-dab93d8f36ad.description: What should I do to become an adult? Akane Amou, who grew up with her parents forbidding any kind of entertainment, is a little bad with "stimulating" stuff, to the point she can't even watch a kissing scene in a drama. Now that she's a highschool student, she somehow wants to overcome it! Those are her intentions, but it's not that easy. Meanwhile, she got acquainted with a movie otaku named Fuyumine. Will she be able to watch an R15 movie...?

chapters.title: The Truth of the Culture Festival
Would You Like Some Movie Food?

4e53b437-5884-4aa8-9ee1-be1028cba03f.title: Ura Baito: Toubou Kinshi
4e53b437-5884-4aa8-9ee1-be1028cba03f.description:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job: a gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.
___

chapters.title: Department Store Staff ③ - Day Off

f31f1c67-13b4-4432-a67d-f1c8f21958a7.title: Ikemen Onee-san wa Sou Yu Me de Miraretai
f31f1c67-13b4-4432-a67d-f1c8f21958a7.altTitle: The Cool Older Sister Wants To Be Seen In That Way
f31f1c67-13b4-4432-a67d-f1c8f21958a7.description:
Saku-nee, a first-year university student whose real name is Housaka Saku, and Shio, a first-year high school student whose real name is Yoshiba Shion, are childhood friends.
Saku-nee is a handsome, princely-type girl, and for Shio she’s someone he looks up to, so she treasured the relationship they had. At the same time, though, she also carried the desire: “I want Shio to see me as a woman!!”

1bb7932c-ca3f-4827-9513-44bd9f0a75e9.title: Darashinai desu, Hotta-sensei!
1bb7932c-ca3f-4827-9513-44bd9f0a75e9.description: Makoto Kuribayashi is your typical high schooler with a not-so-typical after-school gig as a housekeeper. His latest client? None other than his school’s most popular teacher, the gorgeous Rumiko Hotta. But Hotta-sensei is hiding a dirty little secret: she's a total slob, the polar opposite of her flawless public image! Now, Makoto's got the unenviable task of cleaning up after her mess.

chapters.title: Hotta-Sensei, you voice is leaking out

0a6433e3-ad8d-4c4b-88c9-ff925fe7b361.title: Youjo na Majo to Mori no Kuma-san: Isekai de Potion Tsukutte Nonbiri Slow Life ga Shitai no jaga?
0a6433e3-ad8d-4c4b-88c9-ff925fe7b361.altTitle: A Little Witch And The Bear Of The Forest: I Want To Make Potions And Enjoy A Relaxed Slow Life In Another World, no ja~?
0a6433e3-ad8d-4c4b-88c9-ff925fe7b361.description:
After being caught in a bus accident caused by the aftermath of a collision between Earth and another world, a nearly forty-year-old man is given a choice: return to Earth with the accident erased, or begin a new life in another world with a special profession known as a Class.

With little tying him to his old life, he chooses the latter. However, the highest-ranking classes, “Hero” and “Great Sage,” have already been taken. Among the remaining top-tier choices, one particularly strange option catches his eye: “Potion Master.”

Tired of the hustle and bustle of city life, he figures making potions sounds perfect for a quiet and relaxing slow life.

There is just one problem: Potion Master turns out to be an absurdly broken class.

Before long, he uses one of his own potions to transform himself into a little witch, befriends a terrifying magical bear, and becomes far more involved in the affairs of this new world than any peaceful slow life should require.

And so begins the decidedly not-so-slow life of an overpowered little witch and her bear in another world.

chapters.title: The little Witch and the forest bear

d4341560-3715-4912-9b12-c1869e914310.title: Seirei-tachi no Rakuen to Risou no Isekai Seikatsu
d4341560-3715-4912-9b12-c1869e914310.altTitle: Paradise of Spirits and Ideal Life of Different World
d4341560-3715-4912-9b12-c1869e914310.description: It's the Golden Week, and Morizono Yuuta can't wait to spend the next 11 days staying home and conquering all of his games and manga. After a trip to the supermarket to stock up on food however, he found himself stranded in a wasteland with no sight of human. Now he's just gonna have to find a way to live in this world aided only by some magic tools and numerous Spirits whom he came into contact with.

b939206a-34c1-4b9a-b802-0647bfa59f2f.title: Dustland
b939206a-34c1-4b9a-b802-0647bfa59f2f.description:
In the Utsusemi District of Toaru City—where Suzuran All-Boys High School towers over the landscape—a young boy named Asada Hibari has moved into the Nakahara Apartment Complex, a place well known as a supposed haunted building. Still trapped in the shadow of his mother's death, Hibari remains unable to escape his suffocating loneliness. However, a chance meeting with Kobayashi Sanzou, a resident of the same building, begins to lead his youth toward something hotter and more irreplaceable than anything he's ever known!
___
**Alternate Official Raw**: [Young Champion](https://youngchampion.jp/series/d7fffa7610747)

eb4f43a3-aa12-4d10-8026-e6bc19eb0ca6.title: 30-pun Go ni ☆ Onnanoko
eb4f43a3-aa12-4d10-8026-e6bc19eb0ca6.description:
Shinome Shizuku is retiring from being a Magical Girl after 3 years of hard work. As he signs the papers to finalize the process, his fairy, NPopi, has some troubling news for him. He will become a girl in 30 minutes!

A manga about a “guy” who turns into a girl in 30 minutes https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/140575044
